newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai property firm, Tussauds to build theme park.
newsitem.headline: Thai property firm, Tussauds to build theme park.

text.p: Thai property developer Sahaviriya City Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had entered into a joint venture with Britain's Tussauds Group to build Southeast Asia's largest theme park in southeastern Thailand.

An official of Sahaviriya City told Reuters the joint venture agreement, signed on Monday, called for both parties to invest a total of more than five billion baht (US$200 million) to build the theme park in Chachoengsao province, about 50 km (30 miles) southeast of Bangkok.
The theme park is scheduled to open in 1999, the official said.

"Recent market research by Tussauds has shown that the project holds great appeal for its target market of Thai nationals, with over 12 million people living within the catchment area," a Tussauds statement said.

"In the longer term, there will also be the opportunity to draw from the growing number of tourists who visit this country each year," said the statement, quoting Michael Jolly, chief executive officer of Tussauds Group.
The Tussauds Group, a subsidiary of Pearson Plc, the international media group, runs top attactions in Europe that bring in nearly 12 million visitors a year. ($1 = 25 baht)
